svg.aria-label: Two real accelerometer recordings from a MacBook on a hard desk, drawn to the same vertical scale. The upper trace is 60 seconds of a 25-minute session with the machine running Swift builds; its loudest moment reaches about 71 milli-g. The lower trace is 90 seconds of bass-heavy music played through the desk and stays near flat at about 3 milli-g. Neither recording produced a trigger.
svg.text: A real machine doing real work
60 s from a 25-minute recording. Hard desk, Swift builds running, fans up.
peak 74 mg · 60 s at 796 Hz · 0 triggers
The full 90 s recording. 45, 60 and 80 Hz layered bass, laptop speakers at 55.
